args: Edit this exact Yasuo pixel sprite into the BODY LAYER of a southeast-facing sword attack. Preserve his face, swept-back ponytail, blue scarf, silver shoulder armor, clothing palette, pixel scale and character proportions. Give him a confident high stance: chest open, head raised looking southeast, torso leaning slightly forward as a whole, front leg slightly bent and rear leg braced, feet separated front-to-back rather than a wide squat. Remove only the sword-wielding arm on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE below the shoulder armor, leaving a clean shoulder socket for a separate animated arm. Keep the other arm and hand complete and relaxed near the waist. Keep only the scabbard at the waist, no sword or sword handle. One complete head-body-legs sprite on transparency, no detached parts, no effects, no labels.
